control.description-key: A split-panel visit planner showing todays appointments on a list and Azure Maps

property.name: recordId
property.description-key: Sales Visit Plan record ID (auto-detected from form context)

property.name: azureMapsKey
property.description-key: Azure Maps subscription key from portal.azure.com

property.name: lastVisitField
property.description-key: Schema name of the custom last-visit-date field on account (e.g. vis_lastvisitdate)

property.name: workDayStartField
property.description-key: Field on the visit plan entity that stores the work day start time. Defaults to vis_starttime.

property.name: workDayEndField
property.description-key: Field on the visit plan entity that stores the work day end time. Defaults to vis_workdayend.

property.name: planTable
property.description-key: Logical name of the visit plan table. Defaults to vis_salesvisitplan.

property.name: planCollection
property.description-key: Entity set / collection name of the visit plan table, used for @odata.bind. Defaults to vis_salesvisitplans.

property.name: planStatusField
property.description-key: Choice field on the visit plan for plan status write-back. Defaults to vis_status.

property.name: driveMinutesField
property.description-key: Whole-number field on the visit plan for the optimized total drive time roll-up. Defaults to vis_new_totaldriveminutes.

property.name: isPriorityField
property.description-key: Boolean field on the appointment marking a priority visit. Defaults to vis_new_ispriority.

property.name: visitOrderField
property.description-key: Whole-number field on the appointment storing the optimized visit order. Defaults to vis_new_visitorder.

property.name: invitationStatusField
property.description-key: Choice field on the appointment tracking invitation status. Defaults to vis_new_invitationstatus.

property.name: planLookupNav
property.description-key: Relationship / navigation property name that links an appointment to the visit plan, used for @odata.bind and unlink. Defaults to vis_new_salesvisitplanid_Appointment.

property.name: planLookupField
property.description-key: Logical name of the lookup column on appointment that references the visit plan, used to build the OData _value filter. Defaults to vis_new_salesvisitplanid.

property.name: geocodeCountrySet
property.description-key: Comma-separated ISO country codes to bias Azure Maps geocoding. Defaults to DK,SE,NO,DE,NL,BE,FR,GB.

property.name: defaultMapCenter
property.description-key: Map position shown when a plan has no geocoded visits, as lat,lon or lat,lon,zoom (for example 55.68,12.57,11). When empty, a wide northern Europe view is used.
